name: stem-trial-v01
status: frozen before any trial ground truth was generated
question: Fit GIC and our method to the same passive release motion of a clamped stem, predict the response to a known lateral force at 0.75 L, then give both the same measured calibration poke at 0.50 L and re-predict. Score both against held-out 3D motion.

scope_labels.GIC: native official code b523851 on raw multi-view RGB (10 cameras, camera 0 held out) with one labelled adapter: a known external body force added to the MPM grid momentum (G3 parity tests). Density is fixed by native config (1000 kg/m^3), as in GIC's released configs; GIC has no native density parameter.
scope_labels.ours: joint posterior over material scale/density with a linear T10 FEM forward model on a coarser mesh; supplied 3D surface-marker tracks with 1 mm noise (supplied-correspondence stratum, not raw RGB).
scope_labels.truth: independent nonlinear neo-Hookean T10 FEM, Newmark average acceleration with Newton; not GIC MPM, not our linear model, not the same mesh.

geometry_m.clamp: all material with reference x <= -0.20 fixed

world_design: E/rho = 4000 m^2/s^2 in every world. Passive gravity motion depends only on E/rho and nu (exact scaling of the continuum equations), so D0 cannot identify absolute stiffness; a known force can.

D0.load: gravity release from straight rest state at t=0

D1.load: gravity release + 40 N total along +z, uniform body force over material with reference x in [-0.015, 0.015) (0.50 L station), raised by 0.5(1-cos(pi t/0.25)) then held

D2.role: held-out interaction; never used for fitting or selection; generated only after predictions are sealed
D2.load: gravity release + 20 N total along +z, uniform body force over material with reference x in [0.085, 0.115) (0.75 L station), same ramp

truth_numerics.qualification: mesh (22,4,4) and dt/2 differences reported; D2 qualification only after sealing

rendering.background: white; images supplied pre-matted (m_ files identical to r_ files), equivalent to perfect matting

gic.D0_fit: native pipeline on D0 (shared by all worlds because D0 is identical up to solver rounding; identity verified numerically)
gic.D1_refit: native pipeline on each world's D1 video with the force adapter, init_E = D0 fit
gic.prediction: native Simulator from the run's reconstructed particles with the force adapter; stations by particle reference position

ours.markers: 8 surface points: top-centre (y=0.64,z=0) and +z side centre (y=0.60,z=0.04) at x = -0.10, 0.00, 0.10, 0.20
ours.risk: posterior probability that station-centroid RMS error of the point prediction exceeds delta = 3 mm

scoring.primary: RMS over all D2 frames and the four stations of the 3D error in station-centroid DISPLACEMENT from each method's own frame 0 (mm), against truth; removes static reconstruction offsets
secondary: peak lateral displacement of the 0.75 L station
absolute station-centroid position error (includes reconstruction offset)
scoring.rule: predictions for D2 from every method are written and sha256-sealed before D2 truth is generated

limits: One geometry, three worlds; a case study, not a benchmark. Truth is a numerical reference, not measured physics. GIC's fixed density is its native assumption, so this trial tests exactly that assumption plus its refit; ours receives supplied tracks rather than RGB.

amendments.change: primary metric stated as displacement from own frame 0 (was ambiguous: centroid error)
